title: Shiitake Mushrooms and Bok Choy in Garlic Sauce
summary: A quick Chinese-style vegan stir-fry with tender bok choy, savoury shiitake mushrooms and a glossy garlic-soy sauce. It is ideal for a fast weeknight dinner served with rice or noodles.

ingredients.name: bok choy, leaves separated and halved lengthways

steps: Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, brown sugar, cornstarch, black pepper and vegetable stock together in a small bowl until the cornstarch is dissolved.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the shiitake mushrooms and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until browned at the edges and softened.
Add the garlic, ginger and the white parts of the spring onions. Stir-fry for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, taking care not to burn the garlic.
Add the bok choy stems first and stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add the leafy parts and a pinch of salt. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until the stems are crisp-tender and the leaves are wilted.
Pour in the sauce and toss everything together for 1–2 minutes until glossy and lightly thickened, coating the mushrooms and bok choy.
Scatter over the remaining green spring onion slices and serve hot, ideally with steamed rice.
